scope: Authored synthetic contracts and actual local DuckDB/FastAPI/report computations; no live LLM, public-data geocoding, real commercial conclusion or independent human acceptance.
acceptance: Keep all values and provenance visible; suppress ranking/subtraction on incomparable or unverified bases; preserve source binding after later ingestion; never equate missing source with zero; reject unconfirmed or oversized analysis before writes.
percentileDefinition: Among other available comparable sites, fraction strictly below plus half of equal-valued sites, multiplied by 100; null when fewer than two are available.
limits: Two-address synthetic data does not validate full-data coverage or real location suitability.
The explicit text helper is not semantic AI and supports only the declared restaurant scope.
Cancellation, interruption recovery, real data freshness policy and further client environments remain separate work.
